versions.changelog:
Initial release of Search Experience Optimization (SXO) skill:

- Analyzes Google SERPs backwards to detect page-type mismatches and content gaps.
- Derives user stories from search intent signals and scores pages from multiple persona perspectives.
- Provides actionable gap analysis and persona-based improvement recommendations.
- Supports generation of IST/SOLL wireframes based on SERP and persona findings.
- Integrates with DataForSEO for enhanced SERP and keyword data (when available).
- User-invocable commands for SXO analysis, persona scoring, and wireframe generation.
